paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 这门课程介绍审计的基本原理，重点关注财务报表审计。课程涵盖审计的性质、各种审计类型以及注册会计师（CPA）职业的角色。学生将学习审计报告、审计目标，以及审计证据的收集与评价。课程还探讨审计风险模型、不同的审计测试方法和完成审计所需要的程序。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of auditing, focusing on the financial statements audit. It covers key topics such as the nature of auditing, various types of audits, and the role of the CPA profession. Students will learn about audit reports, audit objectives, and the accumulation and evaluation of audit evidence. The course also explores the audit risk model, different audit tests, and the procedures for completing an audit.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
On successfully completing this course, students are expected:

1）To understand the auditing profession including CPA profession, ethics, and legal liability.

2）To know concepts and theories regarding audit objectives, responsibilities, audit evidence, audit report, audit risk, and audit planning.

3)   To  develop a comprehensive understanding of auditing processes.

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: Lectures and tutorials

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
Week 1: Audit and assurance service


Nature of auditing

Distinction between accounting and auditing

Economic demand for auditing

Assurance services

Types of audits

Types of auditors

Certified public accountant (CPA)


Learning Objectives:

1  Describe auditing.

2  Distinguish between auditing and accounting.

3  Explain the importance of auditing in reducing information risk.

4  List the causes of information risk, and explain how this risk can be reduced.

5  Describe assurance services and distinguish audit services from other nonassurance services.

6  Differentiate the three main types of audits.

7  Identify the primary types of auditors.

8  Describe the requirements for becoming a CPA.

 

Week 2: CPA profession 


CPA firms (activities, structures)

Regulations and regulatory bodies (SOX, PCAOB, SEC and AICPA)

Auditing standards (International v.s. US)

Organization of U.S. auditing standards

Quality control


Learning Objectives:

1  Describe the nature of CPA firms and what they do.

2  Describe the structure of CPA firms.

3  Understand the role of the PCAOB and the effects of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act on the CPA profession.

4  Summarize the role of the Securities Exchange Commission in accounting and auditing.

5  Describe the key functions performed by the AICPA.

6  Understand the role of international auditing standards and their relation to U.S. auditing standards.

7  Use U.S. auditing standards as a basis for further study.

8  Identify quality control standards and practices within the accounting profession.

 

Week 3&4: Audit reports 


Standard unmodified opinion audit report

Critical Audit Matters

Emphasis-of-Matter Explanatory Paragraph /Nonstandard Report Wording

Modification to the Opinion in the Audit Report

Materiality

Auditor’s decision process


Learning Objectives:

1  Describe the parts of the standard unmodified opinion audit report for nonpublic entities under AICPA auditing standards.

2  Specify the conditions required to issue the standard unmodified opinion audit report.

3  Understand the Critical Audit Matters

4  Describe the circumstances when Emphasis-of-Matter Explanatory Paragraph /Nonstandard Report Wording can be used in the audit report

5  Identify the types of audit reports that can be issued when an unmodified opinion is not justified.

6  Explain how materiality affects audit reporting decisions.

7  Draft appropriately modified opinion audit reports under a variety of circumstances.

8  Determine the appropriate audit report for a given audit situation.

 

Week 5: Professional ethics


Professional ethics

AICPA Code of Professional Conduct

Independence Rule – Rule 200

SEC and SOX on independence


Learning Objectives:

1  Distinguish ethical from unethical behavior in personal and professional contexts.

2  Explain the importance of ethical conduct for the accounting profession.

3  Describe the purpose and content of the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct.

4  Understand Sarbanes-Oxley Act and other SEC and PCAOB independence requirements and additional factors that influence auditor independence.

Week 6&7: Audit responsibilities and objectives


Objective of Conducting an Audit of Financial Statement

Management’s responsibilities

Auditor’s responsibilities

Financial statement cycles

Management assertions

General and specific audit objectives

How the objectives are met


Learning Objectives:

1  Explain the objective of conducting an audit of financial statements and an audit of internal controls.

2  Distinguish management’s responsibility for the financial statements from the auditor’s responsibility for verifying those statements.

3  Explain the auditor’s responsibility for discovering material misstatements due to fraud or error.

4  Identify the benefits of a cycle approach to segmenting the audit.

5  Describe why the auditor obtains assurance by auditing transactions and ending balances, including presentation and disclosure.

6  Distinguish among the management assertions about financial information.

7  Link transaction-related audit objectives to management assertions for classes of transactions.

8  Link balance-related audit objectives to management assertions.

9  Explain the relationship between audit objectives and the accumulation of audit evidence.

 

Week 8: Audit evidence


Nature of audit evidence

Four audit evidence decisions

Persuasiveness of audit evidence

Types of audit evidence

Audit documentation


Learning Objectives:

1  Contrast audit evidence with evidence used by other professions.

2  Identify the four audit evidence decisions that are needed to create an audit program.

3  Specify the characteristics that determine the persuasiveness of evidence.

4  Identify and apply the eight types of evidence used in auditing.

5  Understand the purposes of audit documentation.

 

Week 9&10: Audit planning and materiality


Analytical procedures


Common ratios

Types of analytical procedures



Audit planning


Accept client and perform initial audit planning

Understand client’s business and industry

Conduct preliminary analytical procedures



Materiality


Materiality for financial statements as a whole

Determine performance materiality

Estimate misstatement and compare with preliminary judgement




Learning Objectives:

1  Know the types of analytical procedures and their purposes.

2  Compute common financial ratios.

3  Discuss why adequate audit planning is essential.

4  Make client acceptance decisions and perform initial audit planning.

5  Gain an understanding of the client’s business and industry.

6  Perform preliminary analytical procedures.

7  Apply the concept of materiality to the audit.

8  Make a preliminary judgment about what amounts to consider material.

9  Determine performance materiality during audit planning.

10  Use materiality to evaluate audit findings.

 

Week 11: Assessing the risk of material misstatement


Overview of audit risk


Audit risk

Risk assessment procedures

Considering fraud risk

Identification of significant risks



Audit risk model

Assessing acceptable audit risk

Assessing inherent risk

Relationship of risks to evidence and factors influencing risk


Learning Objectives:

1  Define risk in auditing.

2  Distinguish the different types of risk assessment procedures.

3  Understand important auditor considerations related to the risk of material misstatement due to fraud.

4  Describe the auditor’s responsibility to identify significant risks.

5  Describe the audit risk model and its components.

6  Assess acceptable audit risk.

7  Consider the impact of several factors on the assessment of inherent risk.

8  Discuss the relationship of risk to audit evidence.

9  Discuss how materiality and risk are related and integrated into the audit process.

 

Week 12&13: Audit of Internal control and control risk


Internal control


Overview

Management’s responsibility

Auditor’s responsibility



COSO framework

Obtain and document understanding

Test of controls

Report on controls


Learning Objectives:

1  Describe the three primary objectives of effective internal control.

2  Contrast management’s responsibilities for maintaining internal control with the auditor’s responsibilities for evaluating and reporting on internal control.

3  Explain the five components of the COSO internal control   framework.

4  Obtain and document an understanding of internal control.

5  Assess control risk by linking key controls and control deficiencies to transaction-related audit objectives.

6  Describe the process of designing and performing tests of controls.

7  Understand how control risk impacts detection risk and the design of substantive tests.

8  Understand requirements for auditor reporting on internal control.

9  Describe the differences in evaluating, reporting, and testing internal control for nonpublic and smaller companies.

 

Week 14: Fraud auditing


Types of fraud

Conditions for fraud

Examples of fraud risk factors

Assessing the risk of fraud

Corporate governance oversights to reduce fraud risk

Responding to the risk of fraud

Specific fraud risk areas


Learning Objectives:

1  Define fraud and distinguish between fraudulent financial reporting and misappropriation of assets.

2  Describe the fraud triangle and identify conditions for fraud.

3  Understand the auditor’s responsibility for assessing the risk of fraud and detecting material misstatements due to fraud.

4  Identify corporate governance and other control environment factors that reduce fraud risks.

5  Develop responses to identified fraud risk.

6  Recognize specific fraud risk areas and develop procedures to detect fraud.

 

Week 15: Overall audit strategy and audit program


Types of audit tests

How to select types of audit tests


Cost of the tests

Types of evidence to select

Relationship between different tests

Evidence mix



Design of an audit program


Introduction

TOC and substantive tests

TDB



Summary of the audit process


Learning Objectives:

1     Use the five types of audit tests to determine whether the financial statements    are fairly stated.

2     Select the appropriate types of audit tests.

3     Understand the concept of evidence mix and how it should be varied in different circumstances.

4     Design an audit program.

5     Compare and contrast transaction-related audit objectives with balance-related audit objectives

6     Understand key evidence-related terms.

7     Integrate the four phases of the audit process.

 

Week 16: Completing the audit


Perform additional tests for presentation and disclosure

Review for contingent liabilities and commitments

Review for subsequent events

Accumulate final evidence

Evaluate results

Issue audit report

Communicate with audit committee and management

Auditor’s responsibility for subsequent discovery of facts


Learning Objectives:

2  Conduct a review for contingent liabilities and commitments.

3  Conduct a post-balance-sheet review for subsequent events.

4  Design and perform the final steps in the evidence-accumulation segment of the audit.

5  Integrate the audit evidence gathered and evaluate the overall audit results.

6  Communicate effectively with the audit committee and management.

7  Identify the auditor’s responsibilities when facts affecting the audit report are discovered after its issuance.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程将系统阐述国际商务的背景和最新发展、国际商务环境（政治法律环境、经济环境、文化环境等）分析、国际商务的重要理论、国际市场的选择与进入模式、跨国经营的战略选择与组织管理、国际战略联盟与战略合作管理、跨国公司在中国的发展、中国企业的国际化等内容。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course will systematically elaborate on the context and recent developments in international business, analyze the international business environment—including the political and legal environment, economic environment, and cultural environment, discuss significant theories of international business, explore the selection of international markets and modes of entry, examine strategic choices and organizational management in multinational operations, address international strategic alliances and cooperative management, investigate the development of multinational corporations in China , as well as the internationalization of Chinese enterprises.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: 本课程旨在为学生提供商务运作的国际视野。通过本课程的学习，并结合国际商务典型案例的分析，学生可以在了解经济全球化跌宕起伏的进程和全球经济活动新规则的背景下，熟悉国际商务的演变和最新发展；掌握国际商务领域的基本知识和原理；掌握国际商务活动中的通行规则与普遍规律，懂得如何应对国际商务的环境挑战；掌握国际化经营的动因、基本方式、国际化经营的进入决策、跨国公司的战略与组织、国际战略联盟的建立与管理等，为今后从事国际商务活动和跨国经营管理工作打下坚实基础。同时，结合中国经济的实际情况，掌握跨国公司在华发展历程与战略动向、中国企业的国际化发展等内容

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
1）课堂讲授 

2）课堂讨论

3）案例分析 

4）小组学期项目（研究、报告、答辩）

paragraphs.content:

第一章 经济全球化的动态与国际商务的发展

第二章 国际商务环境分析

第三章 国际商务理论

第四章 国际市场进入方式分析

小组学期项目的研究计划陈述与讨论

第五章 跨国经营的战略选择与组织设计

第六章 跨国公司在中国的发展与管理

第七章 中国企业的国际化

小组学期项目的报告和答辩

paragraphs.content: In addition to the case analyses and individual assignment, this course also includes a group project that requires students working in groups to conduct research and interview with companies. In the end of the semester, each group is expected to submit a formal report and give a presentation in class.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程系统探讨个体与群体在消费全流程中的行为与心理机制。课程以五大模块为核心：阐释消费者行为学的基础与伦理；剖析感知、记忆、动机等内部影响；解构消费者决策过程与认知偏差；解读消费与自我身份的表达和构建；分析群体、文化等外部力量的深刻塑造，旨在全面理解消费者行为的内在逻辑与外部动因。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course explores the dynamic world of consumer behavior through the lens of Buying, Having, and Being. Students will examine how individuals and groups select, use, and dispose of products, services, and ideas to satisfy needs and express identity. Covering topics from perception and motivation to ethics and sustainability, the course integrates the latest research on digital consumption, social media, and global trends. Using real-world examples and multidisciplinary insights, students will learn to analyze consumer decision-making and develop strategies for responsible marketing in a rapidly evolving marketplace.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
理解消费者行为学的核心概念，掌握感知、学习、记忆、动机、态度、决策、自我概念、群体影响、文化等消费者行为学的基础理论知识。

运用多学科视角综合分析影响消费者决策过程的内部心理机制和外部环境因素。

将消费者行为洞察应用于制定有效的营销策略，包括市场细分、目标市场选择、品牌定位、以及整合营销传播方案的开发。

形成基于证据和符合伦理的决策观念，培养在复杂多变的商业环境中解决实际问题的能力。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
课堂讲授：课堂讲授消费者行为学的基本概念、理论和方法。

案例学习：通过分析真实世界的市场营销案例，在实践中学习和应用消费者行为学相关知识。

小组讨论：通过课上的小组讨论和互动环节，加深对课程内容的学习。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程的主要目标是帮助学生掌握营销研究的核心概念、流程和方法，并学会如何将这些工具应用于解决现实中的商业问题。本课程更加侧重于定量研究方法，以帮助学生应对本领域的最新研究趋势。课程将通过课堂讲授系统介绍市场调研的技术层面，包括定性与定量研究方法，并结合各类文章和案例讨论其在现实商业中的应用。本课程的一个重要组成部分是市场调研项目，学生需要运用所学的市场调研方法，识别并解决一个真实的商业问题。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: The main objective of this course is to equip students with the key concepts, process, and methods of marketing research, and learn how to apply those tools to solve real-life business problems. This course puts more emphasis on quantitative research methods to prepare students for the newest development in the field. We will cover the technical aspects of marketing research (both qualitative and quantitative research methods) through lectures and discuss real life applications using various articles and cases. An important element of this course is a marketing research project where students identify and solve a real business problem using marketing research methods.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
To develop an appreciation for the potential contributions and limitations of marketing

To learn about the steps in the marketing research process, which include problem definition, research design (exploratory, descriptive and causal), data collection methods, questionnaire design, sampling schemes, and data analysis.

To operationalize several key marketing concepts such as customer preference, segmentation, targeting, positioning and new product

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
课程简介（英文）
教学目标
paragraphs.content:
The course is committed to reach the following goals gradually and ultimately with the common efforts of the students:


Introducing the students to key service marketing concepts and facilitating them to have overviews with a framework of theoretical knowledge.

Developing students’ abilities of studying fast-moving marketing situations, in particular, China as an immature market and an emerging market in service industry as well.

Enhancing students’ skills in thinking and decision-making with service marketing perspectives and insights in the complex service environment.

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
The course will be designed as a hybrid course with the integration of online lecture and offline class study.

The course will be organized by introducing the following teaching methods into the course framework, which are the lectures, the individual assignments, the group case studies and the group term project studies.

For the term project study, the following steps of project development are recommended:


The topic of the term project is New Product Development in Service Context. Carefully choose the research object. It could be a totally new-to-the-world service product which you want to introduce into Chinese market, or it is an incremental new product for a real and live brand/company in China.

Draft a research plan for the project, describing the topic, research objectives, questions, procedure, approach, allotment of work, and possible difficulties. The plan is set up by the 3rd

Carry out the plan, continuously discussing and reviewing every process of the project in the group. Referring to the instructor is welcomed.

Draft and revise the report, using complementary and in-depth research.

Finalize the report and prepare the group presentation of the project.

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
Prerequisite Course: This course is only opened to students who are majored in marketing or the students who are majored in business administration and have taken the Marketing Management course or Fundamental of Marketing course as the prerequisite course.

Section 1:  Service Nature and its Implication (Week 1&2, by QIU)


Nature of service industry

Definition of service and service marketing

Core concepts in service marketing

Business implication of service marketing


Section 2:  Service System (Week 3&4, by QIU)


Customer experience

Service quality

Expectation management

Service system

Implication of service journal

Implication of service blueprinting

Group Case I presentation


Section 3:  Service Marketing Communication (Week 5&6, by FAN)


The role of communication in service marketing

Communication Challenges and opportunities in service

Branding of Communication

Service Guarantee

Group Case II report submission

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
本课程旨在通过创新与创业管理的视角，系统理解不同国家微观层面的商业环境。课程内容围绕全球背景下新价值的创造、创新管理过程以及新兴企业的运营展开，系统介绍美国、欧洲、澳大利亚、中国及其他新兴市场国家在创新与创业战略方面的主要特点与实践。

学生将学习全球创新与创业的基本原理、理论及实践，掌握在不同国家运营所需的关键工具、技能与思维方式。课程强调案例分析与实际应用，通过课堂讨论、小组项目、演示及分析性论文等多种教学方式，培养学生分析与评估各国创新与创业管理方法的能力。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: The subject is systematically organized around the creation of new value, processes of innovation management, and operation of new and emerging ventures in global environments. The subject covers major aspects of innovation and entrepreneurship strategy in countries such as U.S., Europe, Australia, China, and other emerging countries.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
The overall aim of this subject is to understand the micro business environment of multiple countries through the lens of managing innovation and entrepreneurship. Students will acquire a broad overview of principles, theories, and practice of innovation and entrepreneurship in global environment, together with an understanding of key tools, skills, and attitudes required to operate in different countries. On successful completion of this subject students should be able to:


Explain the range, scope and complexity of the business environment related to the strategic management of technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship

Analyze and evaluate various approaches to managing innovation and entrepreneurship in different countries

Apply major theories and management tools to the analysis of case studies

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程将有重点地介绍人力资源管理的基本理论和方法。本课程教学内容涉及人力资源管理四大模块：招人、育人、用人和留人。其中，招人模块涉及员工招聘和选拔、育人模块涉及培训开发和职业生涯规划、用人模块涉及绩效管理、留人模块涉及薪酬管理和激励等内容。本课程强调时代性、系统性、可操作性和互动性。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course will focus on the fundamental theories and methodologies of human resource management. The curriculum encompasses four major modules: recruitment, development, utilization, and retention. Specifically, the recruitment module covers employee hiring and selection; the development module addresses training, development, and career planning; the utilization module pertains to performance management; and the retention module involves compensation management and motivation. The course emphasizes contemporaneity, systematic coherence, practicality, and interactivity.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
本课程的主要目标是使大家掌握关键的人力资源管理概念、理论并形成系统的知识体系，培养大家学习人力资源管理的兴趣、应用相应知识分析、解决现实问题。

课程将引入角色扮演和行动学习方法，选择一家模拟企业创造人力资源管理情景，让学生解决这家案例企业所遇到的一系列人力资源管理问题，从而培养学生发现问题、分析问题和解决问题所需具备的人力资源管理技能和思维方式。

采用团队学习方法，提升学习的沟通能力和团队合作能力。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 采用沉浸式教学方式，将教师讲授、角色扮演、行为学习和案例分析融为一体。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
第1-2周: 人力资源管理概述

第3周: 数智化时代的企业和人

第4周：工作分析（小组作业1：某公司部门设置和岗位设置，写部门职责说明书和岗位说明书）

第5周: 人力资源规划

第6周: 人力资源招聘（面试视频分析）

第7周: 人力资源选拔（小组作业2：某公司招聘和面试内容设计）

第8周：培训开发

第9周：职业生涯开发与管理

第10周: 绩效管理 （小组作业3：某公司绩效考核方案设计）

第11周: 薪酬和激励管理（小组作业4：某公司薪酬方案设计）

第12周：考试

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
本课程是一门讨论型（seminar）为主的课程。课程主要内容包括：探索东方尤其中国传统文化中的管理思想以及这些思想在当代管理实践中的价值；探讨当代中国特色的企业管理实践，分析和了解中国文化背景下的管理理论和实践与西方管理理论和实践之间的关系和差异；初步树立东方管理研究的方法和理念。
课程形式以教师讲课、经典著作研讨、案例研究、分组议题研讨、论文研讨为主。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course is primarily seminar-based. Its main content includes: exploring management philosophies within Eastern, particularly Chinese, traditional culture and their relevance to contemporary management practices; examining modern Chinese-style corporate management practices; analyzing and understanding the relationships and differences between management theories and practices rooted in Chinese cultural contexts and those of Western management; and establishing foundational approaches and concepts for research in Eastern management. The course format primarily consists of lectures, discussions of classical works, case studies, group topic discussions, and paper seminars.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
通过本课程的学习，希望学生能达成如下目标：
1)    了解并掌握东方尤其中国传统文化中的一些基本管理思想；
2)    能运用科学的研究方法，去分析本土组织管理的问题；
3)    提高将西方管理理论与中国具体实践结合的技能；

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
1） 教师主讲30%
2） 经典著作研讨 30%
3） 案例讨论 20%
4） 分组议题研讨 20%

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
衍生证券已经是金融市场中一个重要的组成部分，作为金融专业的学生有必要对其原理和运用方法有一个系统的了解。

本课程将介绍基本的衍生证券，包括期货、期权及互换等产品，通过对概念的理解，相关定价理论的介绍，以及衍生品运用的分析讨论，使学生基本掌握衍生品的定价原理和运用方法。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content:
Derivative instruments nowadays are playing an important role in financial markets, and as a finance major student, it is necessary to have a systematic understanding of its principles and application methods.
This course will introduce fundamental derivatives, including futures, options and swaps, through the understanding of concepts, the introduction of relevant pricing theories, and the analysis and discussion of derivatives application, so that students can master the pricing principles and application methods of derivatives.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
本课程的主要目的在于介绍金融衍生证券的基本概念、定价原理和运用方法。

鉴于衍生品的具有复杂性、高杠杆等特点，需要引领学生善于理性思考、警惕投机倾向，在掌握理论知识和分析方法的同时，也要清醒地认识到现实与理论的差异，在需要面对复杂的衍生产品时能理性分析，根据具体情况适当运用。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 教学以课程讲授为主，期间引导鼓励学生参与讨论，课后有作业以巩固学习内容。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 基于现代企业理论，本课程将在学生已经掌握财务管理的基本理论基础上，进一步讲解公司金融政策和公司价值等相关理论和实际案例。具体内容包括基于实物期权、金融契约理论、行为金融理论深入讲解现代公司金融理论框架、内容和例证，解读创新项目价值评估、项目注资方式、经理人薪酬激励、公司股权结构安排等相关理论等。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: Based on the theory of corporate finance, this course will further elaborate on corporate valuation and financial policies along with practical case studies, building upon students having primary knowledge of financial management theories. The specific content mainly includes: Based on the theory of real options, financial contracts, and behavioral finance, this course provides an in-depth explanation of the framework, content, and examples of modern corporate financial operations, and interprets related theories such as innovative project valuation, project segmental capital injection, manager compensation incentives, and company ownership structure arrangements.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: 本课程强调理论联系实际，着重讲解学生公司理财的基本理念方法，要求学生通过课堂表现或网络交流方式积极参与教学内容的讨论与运用，针对课后给出的讨论话题交流个人观点或阅读资料，进行中国上市公司相关案例讨论，进而理解公司市场价值变动，了解并掌握一些公司财务的实务操作。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
讲授为主，专业文献点评与企业典型案例分析相结合；

关注学生在课程群中的讨论，课中将给予明确点评；

注重学以致用，学生将以小组报告形式进行应用交流。

paragraphs.content:
本课程主要内容包括：


剖析公司治理的基本问题，进而阐释公司治理的理论框架。

分别讨论股东权益、董事会模式、独立董事、公司高层管理者激励约束机制等问题；解析内部治理机制对公司管理层和其他利益相关者的战略决策行为的影响。

讨论证券市场与控制权配置等的治理功能；把握集团治理的本质、特点及主要内容，掌握母公司如何既能有效地控制子公司又能保持其活力。

讨论转轨经济中的公司治理变革相关问题和中国公司治理改革的“顶层设计”的基本思路。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content:
The main contents of this course include:

• Analyzing the fundamental issues of corporate governance and further explaining its theoretical framework.
• Discussing shareholder rights, board models, independent directors, and incentive and constraint mechanisms for senior management; analyzing how internal governance mechanisms influence the strategic decision-making behavior of management and other stakeholders.
• Examining the governance functions of securities markets and the allocation of control rights; understanding the nature, characteristics, and key elements of group governance, and how parent companies can effectively control subsidiaries while maintaining their vitality.
• Addressing issues related to corporate governance reform in transition economies and the basic approach to the "top-level design" of China's corporate governance reform.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
教学目的： 

1）介绍公司治理的基本问题和公司治理的理论框架。

2）讨论如何借鉴市场经济发达国家的经验与教训，建立和完善适合国情、与国际接轨的中国公司治理结构与机制。

3）培养能将理论与实践相结合的现代公司治理人才。

基本要求： 

1）了解公司治理的基本问题，把握公司治理的理论框架。

2）了解市场经济发达国家公司治理的经验与教训。

3）将理论与实践相结合，了解如何建立和完善适合国情、与国际接轨的中国公司治理结构与机制。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 从知觉出发介绍人的认知特点；分析有效沟通应考虑的三大原则；在讨论对人对己看法，得出 ‘We are OK !’是可以持续、学习的生活态度的基础上；介绍三大沟通技能，分别是：你/我信息（换位思考式沟通）；自信表达和积极倾听。课程还将讨论人际冲突产生的原因、说服的理论和技能、谈判中的价值创造和索取策略，倾听言外之意、动作表情识别、演讲、有效与自己对话等内容。通过学习，达到系统认识和掌握管理沟通的理论和技能。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: Starting from perception, this course introduces the cognitive characteristics of individuals; analyzes the three major principles to consider in effective communication; and, based on discussing perceptions of oneself and others, establishes that "We are OK!" is a sustainable and learnable life attitude. It then presents three key communication skills: "You/I messages" (empathy-based communication), assertive expression, and active listening. The course will also explore the causes of interpersonal conflicts, theories and skills of persuasion, value creation and claiming strategies in negotiation, recognizing implied meanings, identifying facial expressions and body language, public speaking, and effective self-talk. Through this learning process, students will achieve a systematic understanding and mastery of management communication theories and skills.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: 沟通是人类社会的基本生活方式，是人们通过共同的符号系统进行意见或思想交流的过程。沟通是管理过程的重要组成部分。杰克·韦尔奇（GE前CEO）曾说过:“管理就是沟通，沟通，再沟通。”本课程介绍管理沟通策略的原理和运用方式。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: This course is conducted in English only. Please refer to our Course Description in English.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: The course introduces the basics of managerial communication theories and strategies: audience analysis, communicator credibility, message construction, channel choice and organizational context. Primary focus of the course involves (but not limited to) Interpersonal Communication Skills, Active Listening Skills and Reflective Responses, Organizational Communication and Network, Stakeholder Theory and System Theory, Crisis Communication and Management, Negotiation Strategies and Tactics, Effective Presentation Skills, Cross-cultural Communication and Management, Managerial Writing Strategies and Techniques, Public Relations Management, etc.  Students will study communication theories and discuss business cases in order to analyze and understand the strategic thinking of managerial communication and to apply the skills in communicating with others both within and outside the organization.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: The course is intended to help you think strategically about management communication; sharpen your writing, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills within a managerial setting; and enhance your capacity of critically analyzing corporate communication issues along the line of problem-solving thinking. In our class sessions, we will look at a range of successful practices and guidelines that have been derived from both research and experience, give you the opportunity to develop and practice your skills, and provide you with feedback to help you strengthen them.

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
The course will involve the student as a whole person in the classroom, allow for genuine responses and develop student autonomy. The course will involve a series of readings and business cases related to the range of topics under discussion. Students will be encouraged to develop a more strategic thinking for their communication at work and practice on field samples to develop their communication skills. Class teams will also be invited to present their final project work towards the semester end so that students could apply the course learning into realistic business analyses and strategies. Course requirements also include individual active class performance, course materials reading, enthusiastic participation in group presentations, timely completion of assignments, and proactive contribution to the course progress.

Typically we will use a lecture or workshop format that relies heavily on discussions, in-class exercises and case studies. An honorary corporate guest speaker lecture will be arranged whenever possible during the semester. We also expect the class sessions to be highly interactive.

Course Code: BA30031.03
Course Instructor: Zhiyu Feng

Module I: Course Overview and Major Conceptual Model

Week 1: Course Introduction and Course Overview

Teaching Content:
•    Course objectives, structure, and assessment
•    Importance of managerial communication in organizations
•    Overview of communication models (linear, interactive, transactional)

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand course goals, expectations, and assessment methods
•    Recognize the role of communication in managerial effectiveness
•    Gain familiarity with basic communication models

Week 2: Introduction to Managerial Communication

Teaching Content:
•    Key components: sender, message, receiver, channel, feedback, noise
•    Managerial communication competencies
•    Examples of effective vs. ineffective communication

Teaching Objectives:
•    Identify major elements of communication in managerial contexts
•    Evaluate communication effectiveness using conceptual frameworks
•    Recognize essential managerial communication skills

Week 3: Foundations of Effective Communication

Teaching Content:
•    Principles of clarity, conciseness, and coherence
•    Audience analysis and adapting messages
•    Common barriers to communication and strategies to overcome them

Teaching Objectives:
•    Apply principles of clear and effective communication
•    Adapt communication style to different audiences
•    Identify and address barriers to communication

Module II: Individual Communication

Week 4: Speaking and Listening (I): Theory Session

Teaching Content:
•    Active listening and questioning techniques
•    Speech structure, clarity, and logic
•    Role of verbal and nonverbal communication

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand the theory behind effective speaking and listening
•    Recognize how verbal and nonverbal cues affect understanding
•    Apply listening techniques to enhance comprehension

Week 5: Speaking and Listening (II): Practice Session

Teaching Content:
•    In-class speaking exercises (e.g., presentation)
•    Peer feedback on listening and response skills
•    Practical applications in managerial contexts (e.g., meetings, one-on-ones)

Teaching Objectives:
•    Practice structured speaking and active listening
•    Receive and apply feedback to improve communication
•    Develop confidence in delivering oral messages

Week 6: Business Writing

Teaching Content:
•    Professional emails, memos, and reports
•    Persuasive and analytical writing techniques
•    Tone, clarity, conciseness, and structure in written communication

Teaching Objectives:
•    Write clear, concise, and professional business documents
•    Apply persuasive and analytical writing strategies
•    Tailor written communication to different audiences

Module III: Interpersonal Communication

Week 7: Conflict management

Teaching Content:
•    Sources and types of workplace conflict
•    Conflict resolution styles and strategies
•    Communication techniques for managing conflict

Teaching Objectives:

•    Identify sources and types of conflict in organizations
•    Apply strategies to manage and resolve conflicts
•    Communicate effectively during tense or difficult situations

Week 8: Negotiation

Teaching Content:
•    Fundamentals of negotiation
•    Interest-based negotiation vs. positional bargaining
•    Strategies for effective negotiation and win-win outcomes

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand negotiation principles and frameworks
•    Apply communication strategies in negotiation scenarios
•    Develop skills for reaching mutually beneficial agreements

Week 9: Conducting Interviews (I): Theory Session

Teaching Content:
•    Interviewing objectives and types (selection, performance, informational)
•    Questioning techniques and interview structure
•    Evaluating responses and managing interviewer bias

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand the theory and purpose of different types of interviews
•    Learn effective questioning and evaluation strategies
•    Prepare for structured and effective interviews

Week 10: Conducting Interviews (II): Practice Session

Teaching Content:
•    Role-playing interview scenarios
•    Peer and instructor feedback on interviewing skills
•    Analysis of common mistakes and best practices

Teaching Objectives:
•    Practice conducting professional interviews
•    Apply theory to real-life interview scenarios
•    Improve questioning, listening, and evaluation skills

Module IV: Communication in Teams

Week 11: Managing Team Communication Dynamics 

Teaching Content:
•    Team roles, norms, and decision-making processes
•    Effective meeting management
•    Communication challenges in teams

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand team communication dynamics
•    Apply strategies for effective teamwork
•    Diagnose and resolve communication issues within teams

Week 12: Leadership Communication

Teaching Content:
•    Communicating vision, goals, and feedback
•    Influence and persuasion techniques
•    Building trust and credibility as a leader

Teaching Objectives:
•    Recognize effective leadership communication strategies
•    Develop skills to influence and motivate teams
•    Practice delivering clear and persuasive managerial messages

Week 13: Team Communication: Practice Session

Teaching Content:
•    Team exercises and simulations (e.g., leaderless group discussion)
•    Collaborative decision-making and problem-solving
•    Peer feedback on team communication performance

Teaching Objectives:
•    Apply communication principles in team settings
•    Improve collaborative problem-solving skills
•    Enhance teamwork and communication confidence

Module V: Corporate Communication and Course Reflections

Week 14: Cross-Cultural Communication and Digital Communication

Teaching Content:
•    Cultural frameworks (e.g., Hofstede, Cultural Intelligence) and communication styles
•    Managing communication in global teams
•    Digital communication tools, etiquette, and challenges

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand cross-cultural communication differences
•    Apply strategies for effective communication in virtual/global teams
•    Use digital tools professionally and efficiently

Week 15: Crisis Communication

Teaching Content:
•    Crisis communication frameworks and principles
•    Case studies: corporate crises and responses
•    Writing crisis messages and press releases

Teaching Objectives:
•    Understand the key principles of crisis communication
•    Analyze real-world crisis communication examples
•    Develop skills for crafting appropriate crisis messages

Week 16: Group Presentation and Course Reflections

Teaching Content:
•    Group presentation of a managerial communication case/project
•    Peer and instructor feedback
•    Reflection on learning outcomes and skill development

Teaching Objectives:
•    Demonstrate teamwork and communication skills in a presentation
•    Integrate course concepts into real-world scenarios
•    Reflect on personal growth in managerial communication skills

Week 17: Preparation for Final Exam    

Week 18: Final Exam

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程融合职业责任与领导力，二者互为支撑：领导力是载体，职业责任是目标，领导力可放大职业责任的社会影响力。课程设三大模块：一是阐释课程意义，契合时代需求与个人发展；二是夯实理论基础，涵盖责任内涵、角色与职业责任，及权力、领导特性、行为、团队领导等理论与最新进展；三是构建综合模型，聚焦二者共生，探讨领导力与职业责任的提升路径。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course integrates professional responsibility and leadership, which support each other: leadership is the carrier, professional responsibility is the goal, and leadership can amplify the social influence of professional responsibility. The course consists of three modules: one is to explain the significance of the course, which is in line with the needs of the times and personal development; The second is to lay a solid theoretical foundation, covering the connotation of responsibility, role and professional responsibility, as well as the theory and latest progress of power, leadership characteristics, behavior and team leadership; The third is to build a comprehensive model, focus on the symbiosis between the two, and explore the promotion path of leadership and professional responsibility.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
价值引领：培养学生树立正确的责任观和职业责任意识，塑造优秀的领导力，培养堪当时代大任的未来领导者。

知识传授：使学生系统地掌握职业责任、领导力以及两者逻辑关系等方面的知识体系。

能力培养：通过理论学习和实践锻炼，提高学生履行职业责任的技能，科学修炼学生领导能力，为学生将来的就业和职业生涯发展奠定良好的基础。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程将职业责任与领导力这两个概念融合在一起进行讲授：领导力是载体，职业责任是目标。职业责任是领导力的载体，领导力是职业责任对社会具有更大影响力的突出体现。因此，本课程共分三个模块的基本内容，一是讲授课程的意义和重要性在于社会时代的需要和个人未来发展的需要；二是课程的理论基础部分，包括领导力和职业责任的基础理论与最新理论进展，包括：责任的内涵和外延，关注角色责任和职业责任，以及权力与影响力，领导特性以及领导行为和群体和团队领导等相关理论；三是领导力与职业责任的综合模型，关注责任与领导力的共生，以及如何有效提升领导力和职业责任。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course integrates the concepts of professional responsibility and leadership in a single framework: leadership serves as the vehicle, and professional responsibility is the goal. At the same time, professional responsibility provides the substance through which leadership is enacted, while leadership represents the most visible way in which professional responsibility can generate broader social impact. Accordingly, the course is organized into three modules. The first explains the course’s significance and importance in light of both societal needs in the current era and students’ future professional development. The second covers the theoretical foundations, introducing classic and emerging theories of leadership and professional responsibility, including the meaning and scope of responsibility (with an emphasis on role responsibility and professional responsibility), power and influence, leadership traits, leadership behaviors, and leadership in groups and teams. The third module presents an integrative model of leadership and professional responsibility, focusing on their mutual reinforcement and on how to effectively enhance both leadership and professional responsibility.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程通过讲授与案例分析相结合的方式，系统介绍领导力与职业责任的核心理论与实践工具。课程涵盖责任伦理、领导判断、影响力、跨文化沟通与冲突管理等主题，结合真实组织案例，培养学生在复杂情境中进行有效判断与负责任领导的能力。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course explores the relationship between professional responsibility and leadership in modern organizations. Professional responsibility represents the baseline of professional conduct, guiding individuals to act with integrity, accountability, and awareness of the broader consequences of their actions. Leadership represents the ceiling of professional impact, where individuals influence teams, organizations, and society.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: By the end of the course, students will be able to understand the concept of professional responsibility and its role in organizations, analyze ethical dilemmas across individual, professional, and organizational levels, and recognize how leadership expands the impact of responsibility. The course also develops students’ ability to apply key leadership concepts, including decision making, influence, negotiation, teamwork, and organizational culture. Through case analysis, discussion, and experiential learning, students will strengthen core human capacities essential for responsible leadership, such as critical thinking, communication, and ethical judgment. The course ultimately aims to cultivate students’ sense of responsibility, enhance their leadership capabilities, and prepare them to lead ethically and effectively in a complex and rapidly changing world.

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: This course combines multiple teaching approaches, including conceptual lectures, case discussions, class debates, experiential exercises, team decision-making activities, role plays, team presentations, and guest speakers from industry. These methods are designed to bridge theory and practice, encourage active learning, and develop students’ analytical and interpersonal skills. Students are expected to actively participate in class discussions and exercises, engage thoughtfully with course materials, and contribute to a collaborative learning environment.

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
Week 1 – Course Introduction & Responsibility

Introduction to course themes.
Definition of responsibility.

Week 2 – Professional Responsibility

Concepts of individual, professional, and organizational responsibility.
Discussion different role responsibilities in professional lives through real-world cases

Week 3 – Concept of Leadership I

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
课程主要内容可大致分为三个部分：

一是基本的金融理论，包括利率的期限结构理论和有效市场理论等；

二是金融工具，包括股票、债券、货币市场工具、抵押贷款等；

三是金融机构，包括商业银行、共同基金、保险公司、投资银行等。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content:
This course is composed of three main parts:

1. fundamental financial theories, including term structure theory of interest rate and efficient market theory.

2. financial instruments, including stocks, bonds, money market instrument and mortgage.

3. financial institutions, including commercial banks, mutual funds, insurance companies and investment banks.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: 本课程将系统地介绍基本的金融理论、金融工具和金融机构。包括利率期限结构、有效市场假设等基本理论；股票、债券、各种短期票据等金融工具；商业银行、保险公司、养老基金等金融机构。通过分析各种金融工具的特点、应用场景，以及定价机制，各种金融机构的功能和特点，有效地帮助学生理解金融市场的运作原理。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 教师课堂主讲，学生参与讨论，课后有作业。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
第一周  导论

第二周  金融价格I——利率

第三周  金融价格II——利率结构和有效市场

第四周  金融机构基础

第五周  中央银行

第六周  货币市场

第七周  债券市场I——国债和市政债

第八周  债券市场II——公司债

第九周  股票市场

第十周  抵押贷款市场

第十一周    外汇市场

第十二周    商业银行I——银行业和金融监管

第十三周    商业银行II——银行业的结构与竞争

第十四周    共同基金

第十五周    保险公司和养老金计划

第十六周    投资银行

第十七或第十八周    考试

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 课程以企业的财务报表为核心，分析企业财务信息和对企业进行估值。课程以财务报表分析与估值的六个相互关联且前后有序的步骤构造篇章结构，由表（财务报表）及里（经济活动），充分展现财务报表分析新思维。通过本课程，学生可以掌握财务报告、财务报表分析、与企业估值的原理和操作，分析企业经营、战略、估值及风险。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: The course focuses on the comprehensive analysis of corporate financial statements and equity valuation. It is structured into six interrelated and sequentially progressive steps of financial statement analysis and equity valuation, moving from the external presentation (of financial statements) to the underlying economic activities. This framework highlights innovative methodologies in financial statement analysis. Through this course, students will develop a robust understanding of financial reporting principles, advanced techniques in financial statement analysis, and the methodologies of corporate valuation. This will enable them to critically evaluate business operations, strategic decisions, valuation metrics, and corporate risks in a systematic and analytical manner.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
本课程的教学目标围绕财务报表分析与公司估值的核心内容展开，旨在帮助学生系统掌握相关理论与方法，具体目标如下：


理解财务报表在资本市场中的作用，包括其在资源配置与决策制定中的重要性。

掌握资产负债表、利润表及现金流量表的内容与解读方法，并运用基本面分析技术评估企业经营绩效。

利用财务报表进行股权估值分析，估算企业的内在价值。

分析财务报表披露的会计信息质量，识别潜在的财务与经营风险。


了解我国资本市场的制度特征，及其对财务报表编制与分析的影响。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 主要教学方式为教师讲授、课堂讨论以及小组报告的形式。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
第1周 财务报告、财务报表分析与估值概览（3课时）

1.     财务报表分析概览

2.     财报分析六步骤：识别行业经济特征、识别公司战略、评估财务报表的质量、分析盈利能力和风险、编制预测性财务报表、公司估值

3.     基于有效资本市场的财务报表分析

 

第2周 资产与负债估值和收益确认（3课时）

1.     多种属性的会计模式

2.     资产和负债估值以及相关性与可靠性之间的权衡

3.     收益确认

4.     分析各种交易对财务报表的影响的框架

 

第3周 收益流量与现金流量：理解现金流量表（3课时）

1.     现金流量表的目的

2.     各种现金流活动之间的关系

3.     现金流活动与公司生命周期

4.     理解净利润、资产负债表与现金流之间的关系

5.     编制现金流量表

6.     将现金流量表用于会计处理与风险分析

 

第4-5周盈利能力分析（6课时）

1.     基于各种收益指标的盈利能力分析概览

2.     资产报酬率

3.     普通股权益报酬率

4.     解读资产报酬率与普通股权益报酬率的经济和战略因素

5.     运用财务报表比率的利弊

第1次作业

 

第6周风险分析（3课时）

1.     风险与风险管理的披露

2.     通过分解普通股权益报酬率分析财务柔性

3.     短期流动性风险分析

4.     长期偿债风险分析

5.     信用风险分析

6.     破产风险分析

7.     衡量系统性风险

 

第7周会计质量（3课时）

1.     会计质量

2.     盈余管理

3.     负债确认与计量的会计质量

4.     资产确认与计量

5.     影响盈余持续性的具体事项和条件

6.     评估会计质量的工具

第2次作业

 

第8周 筹资活动（3课时）

1.     权益筹资

2.     债务筹资

3.     租赁

4.     债务筹资的会计处理与报告规则的预期变化

 

第9周投资活动（3课时）

1.     长期经营性资产投资

2.     长期资产的账面价值与市场价值的关系

3.     证券投资

4.     可变利益主体的主要受益人

 

第10周 经营活动（3课时）

1.     收入确认

2.     费用确认

3.     所得税

4.     运用衍生工具规避外币风险和商品价格风险

第3次作业

 

第11周 编制预测性财务报表（3课时）

1.     编制预测性财务报表

2.     预测收入、经营费用

3.     预测资产负债表中的经营性资产和负债

4.     预测财务杠杆、金融资产、普通股权益资本和财务收益项目、平衡资产负债表

5.     预测现金流量表

6.     通过分析预测性财务报表检验预测假设和结果的有效性

7.     敏感性分析

 

第12周 经风险调整的预期报酬率与股利估值法（3课时）

1.     通用估值模型

2.     股利估值法、现金流量估值法与盈余估值法的等效性

3.     经风险调整的预期报酬率

4.     敏感性分析与投资决策

 

第13周 现金流量估值法（3课时）

1.     现金流量估值法的理论基础

2.     估算自由现金流量

3.     现金流量估值模型

4.     敏感性分析与投资决策

 

 

第14周 盈余估值法（3课时）

1.     盈余估值法的理论基础

2.     盈余估值法：实践优势与问题

3.     剩余收益估值法的理论与概念基础

4.     剩余收益模型的实施问题

5.     剩余收益、股利与现金流量估值法的一致性

第4次作业（可能）

 

第15周 市场估值法（3课时）

1.     会计数字的市场倍数

2.     市场价值与账面价值比率和价值与账面价值比率

3.     市盈率和价值与盈余比率

4.     反向推算

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
企业正越来越多地将部分营销工作转向数字技术，如在线付费广告、搜索引擎、社交媒体和移动终端。本课程聚焦于数字营销的理论与应用两大层面。
课程首先从对数字革命的理论认知切入，这一部分会介绍在多媒体、多设备、多渠道环境下消费者行为的新特征，以及如何将消费者分析转化为用于客户关系管理和品牌建设的营销策略。
接下来，课程会深入讲解各类数字营销工具的管理应用知识，包括在线广告、AIGC 营销和社交媒体营销等。与此同时，学生还将学习营销分析的相关应用，涵盖内容分析、网红达人识别、搜索引擎优化、A/B 测试及其他相关数据分析方法。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: Companies are increasingly shifting some of the marketing efforts to digital technologies such as online paid advertising, search engines, social media and mobile. This course focuses on both the theory and application of digital marketing. The course starts with the theoretical understanding of the digital revolution. This part introduces the new characteristics of customer behavior in a multi-media, multi-device and multi-channel environment, and how the customer analysis can be translated into marketing strategies for customer relationship management and brand building. Next, the course delves into managerial understanding of various digital marketing tools, including online advertising, AIGC marketing, and social media marketing. In the meanwhile, students learn applications of marketing analytics including content analysis, social influencer identification, search engine optimization, A/B testing and other related data analytics.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
The course is designed with the following goals in mind.

Students should be able to achieve the following goals:


Have in-depth knowledge of key concepts, theories, and issues in digital marketing.

Make independent assessment of digital marketing strategies of companies.

Understand digital marketing analytics and master some data analysis skills.


Develop sustainable learning habits to learn the emerging digital marketing tools.

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
授课方式: 


In-person weekly lectures: Students should expect to learn the basic concepts of digital marketing through the weekly in-person lectures.

Individual assignment: Students should be able to test and enrich their understandings via case analyses.

Team-based business simulation: Students can simulate the role of company interns and gain practical learning experience in a real business environment.

Team-based project: All of these serves to benefit and prepare the students for the final team-based project presentation and report preparation.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 在《高级财务会计》课程中，将继续深入学习企业如何处理在复杂经营环境中遇到的会计问题，包括所得税会计、公司合并、集团公司合并财务报表的编制，跨国经营中的外币业务和跨国投资中遇到的外币报表折算等问题。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: In the Advanced Financial Accounting course, we will further explore how enterprises address accounting issues arising in complex business environments, including income tax accounting, business combinations, preparation of consolidated financial statements for corporate groups, and foreign currency transactions in cross-border operations and investments.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
本课程学习企业如何处理在复杂经营环境中遇到的会计问题，学生通过课程学习，应完成如下学习目标：
（1）结合本学期所学的几大会计专题，描述各项业务的会计处理原则。
（2）描述合并财务报表的结构、报表项目内容和各项目之间的逻辑关系。
（3）能运用合适的会计原则，记录复杂经营环境中发生的合并业务、合并财务报表、外币业务等。
（4）结合企业的商业模式、公司战略、运用相关的会计理论来分析企业运营中的财务会计问题等。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
1、本课程采用线下学习的教学方式。课件、上市公司报表、课堂讨论的小案例等资料会提前上传到eLearning上。
2、课堂以讲授知识为主，根据课程内容，课堂上会安排随堂练习、课堂讨论等学习活动，课后有个人作业。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程聚焦财务报表信息在资本市场的定价与反应。立足会计学视角，结合大样本与统计方法，讲授财务报表分析与资本市场基本面投资策略的构建。提炼资产质量、资本结构、利润质量、现金流量质量等关键信息，构建与评估投资组合，并据此开发与检验基于报表的多因子模型，搭建从财务信息到投资决策的逻辑链条。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course examines how financial statement information is priced and reflected in capital markets. Grounded in an accounting perspective and leveraging large-sample data and statistical methods, it covers financial statement analysis and the construction of fundamentals-based investment strategies. We distill key signals—asset quality, capital structure, earnings quality, and cash-flow quality—into tradable factors, build and evaluate portfolios, and develop and test statement-based alpha models, thereby linking financial information to investment decisions.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
1）掌握会计和财务的基础知识，理解资产负债表、利润表和现金流量表中的关键项目。

2）基于财务数据，有逻辑地提取反映公司质量的核心因子。

3）将财务报表数据与资本市场相结合，运用多因子模型探索投资机会。运用实证研究方法，理解资本市场基本面投资背后的会计信息机理，搭建从财务信息到投资决策的完整逻辑链条。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 课程讲授、案例分析、课堂展示

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排

第三周 资产负债表之流动资产与资产质量因子2

第四周 资产负债表之流动资产与资产质量因子3

第七周 资产负债表之非流动资产与资产质量因子3、构建单因子模型

第八周 资产负债表之负债与资本结构质量因子

第九周 资产负债表之所有者权益与资本结构质量因子

第十周 因子分享

第十一周 利润表之营业收入、成本与利润质量因子

第十二周 利润表之费用与利润质量因子

第十三周 利润表之利润与利润质量因子、构建多因子模型

第十四周 现金流量表与现金流量质量因子1

第十五周 现金流量表与现金流量质量因子2

第十六周 因子分享

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程关注从客户价值的视角分析产品创新管理的过程，包括机会识别、概念产生、概念评估、新产品开发和新产品上市，从而培养学生在新产品设计和开发中的创新性思维，并关注企业的社会责任，从而最终实现企业（组织）的可持续发展。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course focuses on analyzing the process of product innovation management from the perspective of customer value, encompassing opportunity identification, concept generation, concept evaluation, new product development, and product launch. It aims to cultivate students' innovative thinking in the design and development of new products while emphasizing corporate social responsibility, ultimately contributing to the sustainable development of enterprises (organizations).

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
价值引领：科学精神，专业素养

价值引领：理念信仰，人文情怀

知识传授：掌握产品创新管理体系；

知识传授：掌握产品创新的分析方法与技术，以及相关的决策模型与工具；

能力培养：具备对产品创新管理基本的外文文献阅读和理解能力；

能力培养：具有初步实践能力，撰写一个产品创新项目的市场导入计划。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
理论讲授：课堂讲授基本的概念、理论和方法。

课堂讨论：针对具体知识点设计情景进行讨论，鼓励学生讨论中的参与和分享，以促进学生对问题的思考和深度挖掘。

文献阅读：选取在新产品创新管理领域经典和前沿的学术研究成果为阅读文献，针对新产品的构思提出、概念筛选、产品开发、市场导入等主题，以小组为单位，深入理解每个主题的研究背景、研究问题、研究方法、研究过程、研究结论及研究意义和启示，并进行主题讲演和点评。

小组作业：本课程选取产品创新章程（PIC）和产品协议（Product Protocol）两个主题，使用小组讨论、情景模拟等方式进行分析和讨论，并以小组为单位完成书面报告。

学期项目：学生以团队方式，以现实环境为背景，设计一个新产品或服务项目，给出项目的市场导入规划（营销规划）。项目贯穿于整个学期，要求从选题、收集信息、设计研究方法、分析数据，到提出解决方案。方案内容包括：市场现状描述和新产品描述；（2）总结机会和问题；（3）战略策划（目标/STP定位/4P或4C的营销策略）；（4）经济分析等方面。目的是引导学生对所学知识的综合运用，并使学生提高团队交流和协作的能力

小组讨论：针对文献阅读、案例分析和学期项目以小组为单位，进行小组内部的沟通和交流。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程关注从客户价值的视角分析产品创新管理的过程，包括机会识别、概念产生、概念评估、新产品开发和新产品上市，从而培养学生在新产品设计和开发中的创新性思维，并关注企业的社会责任，从而最终实现企业（组织）的可持续发展。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course focuses on analyzing the process of product innovation management from the perspective of customer value, encompassing opportunity identification, concept generation, concept evaluation, new product development, and product launch. It aims to cultivate students' innovative thinking in the design and development of new products while emphasizing corporate social responsibility, ultimately contributing to the sustainable development of enterprises (organizations).

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
价值引领：科学精神，专业素养

价值引领：理念信仰，人文情怀

知识传授：掌握产品创新管理体系；

知识传授：掌握产品创新的分析方法与技术，以及相关的决策模型与工具；

能力培养：具备对产品创新管理基本的外文文献阅读和理解能力；

能力培养：具有初步实践能力，撰写一个产品创新项目的市场导入计划。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
理论讲授：课堂讲授基本的概念、理论和方法。

课堂讨论：针对具体知识点设计情景进行讨论，鼓励学生讨论中的参与和分享，以促进学生对问题的思考和深度挖掘。

文献阅读：选取在新产品创新管理领域经典和前沿的学术研究成果为阅读文献，针对新产品的构思提出、概念筛选、产品开发、市场导入等主题，以小组为单位，深入理解每个主题的研究背景、研究问题、研究方法、研究过程、研究结论及研究意义和启示，并进行主题讲演和点评。

小组作业：本课程选取产品创新章程（PIC）和产品协议（Product Protocol）两个主题，使用小组讨论、情景模拟等方式进行分析和讨论，并以小组为单位完成书面报告。

学期项目：学生以团队方式，以现实环境为背景，设计一个新产品或服务项目，给出项目的市场导入规划（营销规划）。项目贯穿于整个学期，要求从选题、收集信息、设计研究方法、分析数据，到提出解决方案。方案内容包括：市场现状描述和新产品描述；（2）总结机会和问题；（3）战略策划（目标/STP定位/4P或4C的营销策略）；（4）经济分析等方面。目的是引导学生对所学知识的综合运用，并使学生提高团队交流和协作的能力

小组讨论：针对文献阅读、案例分析和学期项目以小组为单位，进行小组内部的沟通和交流。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
在当今互联互通的世界中，学生、创业者以及企业高管们理解源于中国并正在向全球传播的创新浪潮至关重要。在这过程中、其所面临的限制条件及其独特特征，对于把握由此带来的机遇具有关键意义。

本商业课程将深入剖析中国的商业环境，提供宝贵见解。课程将探讨促使中国采取开放政策、发展出口导向型经济及其后续发展的基础，并分析中国近年来向以创新为核心的高科技经济转型的趋势及其内在挑战。

课程还将聚焦中国的科技行业、充满活力的互联网格局以及人工智能生态系统，探索中国企业家如何改变交通、绿色产业、汽车、最后一公里配送、微出行、零售、金融、娱乐、机器人、能源和人工智能等传统行业。

此外，课程将梳理中国的现代化政策，包括“中国制造2025”、“中国互联网”以及最新五年规划，分析这些政策对中国发展的意义，以及它们对商业环境和社会的影响。课程内容还涉及人工智能及其对中国社会、经济与文化的影响。

最后，本课程将探讨中国的“一带一路”倡议及其在国际舞台上的关键作用。

总体而言，本课程旨在帮助学生建立起对中国细致而深入的理解——中国不仅是商品供应国，更是一个具备巨大国际化潜力的商业创新型经济体。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content:
In today's interconnected world, it is crucial for students, entrepreneurs, and executives to comprehend the wave of innovation originating from China and spreading globally. Understanding this process, its constraints, and its distinct characteristics is vital to capitalizing on these opportunities.

This business course offers valuable insights into the Chinese business landscape. It examines the foundations that led China to adopt open policies, fostering an export-based economy and its subsequent development, and the recent shift towards an innovation based high-tech economy, along with its inherent challenges.

The course also delves into China's technology sector, its dynamic internet landscape and artificial intelligence ecosystem, exploring how Chinese entrepreneurs are transforming traditional industries such as transport, green industries, automotive, last-mile delivery, micro-mobility, retail, finance, entertainment, robotics, energy and artificial intelligence, among others.

Additionally, it reviews China's modernization policies, including China 2025, China Internet, and the latest Five-Year Plan, analyzing their implications for China's development and their impact on the business environment and society. The course also covers Artificial Intelligence and its influence on Chinese society, economy, and culture.

Finally, the course examines China's Belt and Road Initiative and its pivotal role in the international arena.

Overall, this course provides students with a nuanced understanding of China, not merely as a supplier of goods but as a business innovative economy with significant potential for internationalization.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
Understanding the shift from factor accumulation (investment-led growth) to Total Factor Productivity (TFP) as the primary engine for China's future growth.

Evaluating the "Government + Market" Nodal Economy model: how state strategic investments create spillover effects that private markets capitalize on.

Analyzing firm-level efficiency in China by contrasting "Big" companies (revenue-driven) with "Great" companies (driven by Return on Invested Capital - ROIC).

Understanding the shift of the Chinese economy from export and infrastructure investment to a service-centered, consumption-based, and innovation-driven model, and its effects on business.

Examining the factors that drove China's manufacturing dominance and how new social, cultural, and economic factors are transforming the country.

Understanding the policies and processes that have made China a leader in green energy.

Understanding China's modernization policies (e.g. China 2025, China Internet, Five-Year Plan) and their implications for development, business, and society.

Differentiating between market-oriented and state-planned economies.

Challenging the idea that China is only a producer of commodities and a copier, not an innovator.

Critically evaluating the drivers of major trends in China and their domestic and international effects.

Understanding how Chinese entrepreneurs are changing traditional industries (e.g. green industries, automotive, last-mile delivery, micro-mobility, retail, finance, entertainment, AI).

Understanding China's growing technology sector and competitive internet environment.

Understanding AI developments in China.

Understanding China's international foreign investment landscape and reasoning.

Understanding how innovation has changed in China, how a state-run innovation system is being developed, and which industries will benefit from this.

Understanding China as a new business model.

Understanding China's current technological landscape and its effects.

Understanding China's complex and competitive business environment.

Understanding the characteristics that make Chinese entrepreneurs world-class innovators.

Understanding China's innovative business environment; from sponges to innovators.

Understanding the efficiency of Chinese business logistics.

Understanding the future of supply chains and business, using China as a case study.

Understanding how to conduct business in China.

Understanding China's OBOR initiative and its impact.

Understanding theoretical supply chain concepts.

Application and use of supply chains in modern business: studying real supply chain structures in existing corporations.

This presentation will count as participation.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程旨在通过讲授品牌的整合管理与整合传播的理论、工具和方法，使学生能够掌握（1）品牌的基本概念与逻辑；（2）如何从多角度构建与管理品牌资产，掌握设计品牌多维度传播方案的科学方法；（3）进行品牌延伸和联合，运用各种传统媒与新媒体进行品牌危机管理的能力

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course is designed to impart theoretical knowledge, tools, and methodologies related to integrated brand management and integrated communication. It aims to equip students with the ability to (1) understand the fundamental concepts and underlying principles of branding; (2) construct and manage brand equity from multiple perspectives, mastering systematic approaches to designing multidimensional brand communication strategies; and (3) execute brand extension and co-branding initiatives, as well as apply various traditional and new media platforms for effective brand crisis management.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: 本课程立足复旦“立德树人、服务国家、追求卓越”的办学定位，面向具备良好理论基础与国际化视野的学生，紧扣新闻传播、市场营销等相关专业人才培养要求，致力于培养具有高度社会责任感与文化自信的品牌传播人才。课程注重价值引领，引导学生理解品牌传播中的伦理规范、社会责任与文化认同；系统传授品牌战略、整合传播、消费者洞察等核心理论知识；着力培养学生具备品牌定位、传播策划、跨媒介执行、效果评估等实践能力，以及创新思维、团队协作与数据分析素养，使其能够胜任新时代品牌建设与传播管理工作。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
本课程有两个基本要求：（1）要求所有选课学生在课堂上能完成课程指定的文献资料的阅读和口头展示；（2）要求所有学生能围绕特定品牌做市场分析并制定营销传播方案，并完成个人作业报告。

本课程属性属于研讨型课程，授课方式主要包含：（1）教师课堂讲授（包括在线视频）；（2）学生阅读文献资料的展示、师生讨论与教师点评；（3）课堂案例分析；（4）企业品牌管理案例调研与实践报告（个人作业）。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 利用定量数据分析来指导、制定乃至自动化营销决策正变得日益可行。这在很大程度上归功于数据通常易于获取且经济高效。通过一系列定量分析案例，我们将探讨如何将成熟的营销科学框架与前沿数据分析工具相结合，从而革新企业的营销决策流程，并在行业竞争中获得关键优势。 本课程将涵盖以下定量方法：客户终身价值的学习与估算、客户细分、客户获取与增长、偏好与需求的测量、推荐与个性化、产品管理、广告投放、客户留存与流失，以及客户需求的挖掘。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: It is increasingly possible to use analysis of quantitative data to inform, make, and even automate marketing decisions. This is possible in the sense that the data is often available or economical to collect. Through a series of quantitative analytics cases, we study how the proven marketing science frameworks can combine with cutting-edge data analytics tools, to transform companies’ marketing decision making, and gain a critical edge in their business domain. We will cover quantitative approaches to: learning customer lifetime value, customer segmentation, customer acquisition and viral growth, measuring preferences and demand, recommendations and personalization, product management, advertising, retention and churn, and discovering customer needs.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
本课程结合案例分析与数据分析的方法,帮助学生掌握如何把营销管理的理论与概念应用于营销决策建模。具体而言，学生学习掌握分析与构建模型,求解模型,解释模型分析结果的过程.本课程将有助于培养学生在商业科学分析,营销模型运用,以及批判性思考等方面的能力。

课程目标在于使学员具备启动、参与、管理和评估具有显著商业价值的营销分析项目的能力。为此，学员既需掌握统计学、机器学习与人类行为交叉领域的基础理念，也需熟悉若干具体技术。要实现高效且具影响力的分析，往往需要在严谨性、速度、可重复性和可解释性之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 课程教授,课堂讨论,案例分析, 数据分析上机实践,作业

paragraphs.content: 资本资产定价理论是现代金融学理论的支柱，被广泛的运用于风险分析，金融产品定价，投资决策分析及业绩评定等诸多方面。本课程主要讲授基于诺贝尔奖获得者的资本资产定价经典理论；课程也将简单介绍金融市场中的前沿问题，尤其是大数据及人工智能在资产定价和投资中的应用。除了理论方法的讲授外，课程还将培养学生使用统计分析软件对真实市场数据进行分析。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: The capital asset pricing theory is a cornerstone of modern financial theory and is widely applied in various aspects such as risk analysis, financial product pricing, investment decision analysis, and performance evaluation. This course mainly teaches the classic capital asset pricing theory based on the Nobel Prize winners; it will also briefly introduce cutting-edge issues in financial markets, especially the application of big data and artificial intelligence in asset pricing and investment. In addition to teaching theoretical methods, the course will also train students to use statistical analysis software to analyze real market data.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
本课程为高年级本科生开设。通过本课程的学习，学生将

（1）全面了解资本资产定价理论的发展，应用，及未来发展方向，并能归纳及陈述这些理论的基本原理；

（2）在实践中能正确的选择相关理论，模型，及方法进行投资决策分析；

（3）能够熟练使用目前市场中常用的技术分析工具并进行真实数据分析；

（4）把资产定价理论和实践操作关联起来，为进入金融机构工作或进一步学习深造打下坚实的基础。

（5）通过案例学习，识别金融市场中的欺诈和诚信问题，使学生树立正确的金融市场交易行为。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 以授课老师讲授为主，学生也会要求做课堂报告和简单数据分析。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
本课程主要讲授基于诺贝尔奖获得者的资本资产定价经典理论及相关前沿问题，主要涵盖以下主题:

主题 1：股票和债券定价理论回顾（Bond and Stock Valuation）

Readings: RWJJ: chapters 1, 4, 8, 9.

主题 2：风险与收益关系：初步实证证据 (Risk and Returns: Historical Evidence)

Reading: Lecture notes

主题 3: 期望效用理论及证券组合选择（Expected Utility and Portfolio Choice）

Reading: Lecture notes

主题 4：均值-方差证券组合理论及应用（Mean-Variance Portfolio Theory and Applications）

Reading: Lecture notes.

主题 5：资本资产定价模型（The Capital Asset Pricing Model）

Reading: Lecture notes.

主题 6: 因子模型与因子投资 (Factor Models and Factor Investing)

Reading: Lecture notes.

主题 7：市场有效性及收益预测性（Market Efficiency and Return Predictability）

Reading: Lecture notes.

主题 8：大数据、人工智能与投资（Big Data and AI in Investments）

Reading: Lecture notes.

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程系统介绍商业、工业及住宅地产市场，涵盖抵押贷款类型（固定/浮动利率）、估值方法及融资渠道分析。学生将学习二级市场运作、证券化结构及杠杆效应，并通过案例研究掌握房地产投资评估与决策技能。课程注重培养市场分析、投资建议及团队协作能力，结合实践项目强化逻辑思维与专业演示技巧，为房地产金融与投资领域的职业发展奠定基础。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to real estate markets, covering commercial, industrial, and residential properties. Students will analyze mortgage types (FRM, ARM) and financing options, apply valuation techniques, and evaluate investment opportunities. Key topics include secondary market dynamics, securitization, and the role of leverage. Through case studies and projects, learners will develop analytical, decision-making, and presentation skills while gaining practical experience in real estate investment analysis. Emphasis is placed on critical thinking, teamwork, and communication to prepare students for careers in real estate finance and investment.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
Value




Differentiate between commercial, industrial, and residential real estate




Identify mortgage types (e.g., FRM, ARM) and explain their key features




Apply standard investment valuation methods to real estate


Knowledge




Calculate payments for FRMs/ARMs and evaluate mortgage choices




Analyze major secondary market players and their functions




Explain securitization’s structure and role in real estate markets




Compare commercial financing sources and assess leverage impact


Ability




Conduct real estate investment analysis and provide recommendations




Develop critical skills:




Creative problem-solving




Self-directed learning




Leadership and teamwork




Analytical and communication skills




Professional presentation techniques

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: Instruction will be the main teaching method of the course. Student will also contribute to the class and larn by doing case analysis and group presentation.

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
1: Introduction to Real Estate Finance

2: Mathematics of Real Estate Finance and Mortgage Instruments: Fixed Rate Mortgages (part 1)

3: Mortgage Instruments: Fixed Rate Mortgages (part 2)

4: Mortgage Instruments: Adjustable-Rate Mortgages (part 1) Individual assignment

5: Mortgage Instruments: Adjustable-Rate Mortgages (part 2)

6: Incremental Borrowing Cost, Loan Refinancing

7: Mid-term exam (1.5 hours, closed-book)

8: Residential Mortgage Banking, Mortgage Origination and Underwriting

9: Real Estate Market and the Global Financial System

10: Introduction to Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs)

11: Introduction to Commercial Real Estate Development

12: CRE Valuation and Investment Analysis at the Micro-Level

13: Property Cash Flows Proforma 

14: Real Estate Proforma Modeling (Monthly Cash Flow) Scenario Analysis

15: Portfolio Theory and Asset Price Theory

16: Group Presentation

17-18: Final exam (2 hours, closed-book)

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 财务报告的目标是向财务报告使用者（包括投资者、债权人、政府及其有关部门和社会公众等)提供与企业财务状况、经营成果和现金流量等有关的会计信息，反映企业管理层受托责任履行情况，有助于财务报告使用者作出经济决策。本课程旨在介绍财务报告的基本理论和方法，包括编制财务会计的三大报表，对特殊的经济交易和事项进行会计处理和列报。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: The objective of financial reporting is to provide accounting information about an enterprise’s financial position, operating results, and cash flows to users of financial reports (including investors, creditors, government agencies, and the general public). This information demonstrates the fulfillment of management’s stewardship responsibilities, thereby assisting users in making economic decisions. This course introduces the fundamental theories and methodologies of financial reporting, covering the preparation of the three key financial statements and the accounting treatment and presentation of specific transactions and events.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
学生完成本课程后将能够：

(1) 理解财务报告理论内核，恪守诚信透明的社会责任与会计职业道德要求，服务中国经济高质量发展；

(2) 掌握资产负债表、利润表、现金流量表及权益变动表的编制技术；

(3) 对并购、复合金融工具、股权激励计划、投资性房地产等特殊交易进行合规会计处理与列报；

(4) 结合双碳目标、数字转型等国家战略，在财务报告中体现可持续发展观

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
本课程以讲授为主，在授课过程中注重学生主动学习，同时根据授课内容，穿插案例分析等形式丰富的学习活动，并利用eLearning平台为学生提供习题操练。
•    课堂讲授：在课堂讲授中穿插财务报告小案例，启发学生思考并参与课堂讨论，对于涉及会计处理的重要内容，让学生进行随堂练习后组织学生对问题进行讨论。
•    习题操练：利用eLearning平台发布章节配套习题和反馈。
•    案例分析：结合实务案例提升对财务报告实践的理解。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
教学内容安排：
第一周 绪论
第一节    财务报告与资本市场
第二节    决策有用观
第三节    受托责任观

第二周 – 第三周 财务报表编制与监管
第一节    资产负债表
第二节    利润表
第三节    现金流量表
第四节    财务报告监管要求

第四周 资产负债表日后事项
第一节    资产负债表日后事项的定义及分类
第二节    调整事项
第三节    非调整事项

第五周 会计政策、会计估计变更及会计差错更正

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 《营销创意思维》课程将着重于从营销角度讲授如何运用逻辑创新思维法的方法架构来进行创意，并进而得出创新的解决方案。该课程通过深入分析营销创新领域众多案例，帮助学生学习掌握商业体系中各种系统化的、逻辑性的及可复制的创意方法， 来持续的挖掘出有价值的创新解决方案创意。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course focuses on teaching the Logical Creative Thinking (LCT) methods from a marketing perspective. Through in-depth analysis of numerous cases in the field of marketing innovation, this course aims to equip participants with systematic, logical, and replicable creative methods within business systems, enabling the continuous generation of valuable solution-oriented ideas. LCT integrates logic into the innovation process framework, encompassing a suite of tools designed to uncover effective solutions.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
1）学生能够理解并掌握逻辑创新思维法的基本原理和方法论，能够熟练运用 LCT 工具进行创新，并提出新的、不显而易见的、有价值的创新解决方案。
2）学生能够在复杂多变的商业环境中，积极运用所学的 LCT 方法，识别市场机会，发现潜在问题，能提出有价值的创新解决方1）案，并评估其价值，以筛选出真正创新和有价值的解决方案。

paragraphs.content:
讲座（60%）

课堂讨论（20%）

小组项目（20%）

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content:
毕业实习是本专业本科培养体系中的关键实践环节，旨在打通“课堂—企业—社会”的最后一公里。本课程要求学生在真实商业环境中，将所学的市场调研、消费者行为、企业管理、数字化建设等理论知识转化为解决实际问题的能力。实习单位涵盖快消、互联网、金融、咨询、新零售、文化创意及新兴科技企业等多个行业，鼓励学生深入一线业务场景，参与市场策划、用户运营、数据分析、企业信息系统建设、AI推广等核心工作。
作为指导教师，我将全程协同企业导师，通过定期线上/线下指导、阶段性报告审阅、中期检查与终期核查等方式，确保实习过程兼具专业深度与职业素养培养。本课程不仅是一次岗位体验，更是学生从“校园人”向“职场人”转型的重要过渡，为其未来就业或深造奠定坚实基础。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content:
The graduation internship is a critical experiential component of the undergraduate curriculum in this major, designed to bridge the "last mile" between classroom learning, enterprises, and society. This course requires students to apply theoretical knowledge—acquired in areas such as market research, consumer behavior, business management, and digital transformation—to solve real-world business challenges within authentic commercial environments.
Internship placements span multiple industries, including fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), internet and technology, finance, consulting, new retail, cultural and creative sectors, and emerging tech enterprises. Students are encouraged to immerse themselves in frontline business operations and participate in core activities such as marketing planning, user operations, data analysis, enterprise information systems development, and AI-driven initiatives.
As the faculty supervisor, I will work closely with on-site company mentors throughout the internship period. Through regular online/offline guidance sessions, review of progress reports at key milestones, mid-term evaluations, and final assessments, I aim to ensure that the internship experience integrates both professional depth and the cultivation of workplace competencies.
This course is far more than a job shadowing opportunity—it serves as a pivotal transition for students as they evolve from "campus learners" into "professional practitioners," laying a solid foundation for their future careers or graduate studies.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
通过为期8–12周的全职毕业实习，学生应达成以下目标：


理论联系实际：能够运用信息管理核心理论（如数据分析，信息系统战略分析，AI应用等）分析企业真实问题，并提出可行建议；

提升职业能力：掌握市场调研、竞品分析、内容策划、数据可视化、AI应用等职场通用技能，熟悉企业运作流程与团队协作机制；

强化数字素养：在数字化营销实践中，熟练使用主流工具（如Excel、SPSS、Tableau、社交媒体后台、CRM系统等），理解AI、大数据在企业决策中的应用；

培养职业伦理与责任感：遵守企业规章制度与商业保密原则，树立诚信、责任、合作的职业价值观；

明确职业发展方向：通过沉浸式岗位体验，反思个人兴趣、能力与行业需求的匹配度，形成清晰的职业规划意识。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 通过本课程学习，建立进行学术研究的科学思维，了解和掌握行为科学研究的基本概念和步骤流程，初步掌握行为研究的思路和方法。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: Through this course, students will develop a scientific mindset for academic research, understand and master the basic concepts and procedural steps of behavioral research, and gain a preliminary grasp of the approaches and methods used in behavioral studies.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
建立科学思维
培养严谨、系统、实证的科学思维方式，能够运用批判性思维审视研究问题，掌握假设提出、变量操作、逻辑推演与因果推断的基本科学方法，形成以证据为基础的学术研究习惯。




掌握从研究选题提出到研究设计和汇报的全过程
系统掌握行为科学研究的完整闭环流程：从发现研究问题、查阅文献、凝练研究选题，到进行研究设计、数据收集与分析，直至最终撰写学术论文或研究报告，并进行有效的学术汇报与交流。




掌握学术论文研究方法的理解与评估能力
深入理解各类研究方法（如实验法、观察法、调查法等）的核心原理、适用情境与局限性，能够准确评估已发表学术论文中研究方法的质量、效度与严谨性。




掌握行为研究的主流方法，包括问卷设计和实验设计等
熟练掌握行为科学研究中最核心的几种方法：




问卷设计： 能够设计信效度良好的量表与调查问卷。




实验设计： 掌握实验室实验与现场实验的设计逻辑，熟悉变量控制、随机分配等关键技术。






培养独立科研和科研合作能力
一方面，培养独立开展研究项目的能力，包括自主规划、执行和解决问题的能力。另一方面，通过模拟或真实的团队研究项目，培养在科研团队中的协作、沟通、分工与整合能力。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程邀请各系知名教授以讲座或授课的方式，帮助学生了解管理学各个领域的前沿内课程内容不仅涉及学科最前沿的研究，还包括对学科理论发展脉络的梳理以及对学科容。中一些基本问题的探讨。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course invites renowned professors from various departments to help students understand the frontiers of various fields of management by means of lectures or lessons. The course content not only involves the most cutting-edge research in the discipline, but also includes the theoretical development of the discipline as well as the discussion of some of the basic issues in the discipline. The course also includes a review of the theoretical development of the discipline as well as a discussion of some of the basic issues in the discipline.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
1.向学生提供管理学各个领域最前沿的研究，使学生能够了解各部分内容理论的定义、产生及发展，并能够掌握常见的分析方法。
2.使学生掌握所学内容的分析方法和工具，并能够独立的从事相关内容的科学研究工作。
3.培养学生对学术研究的兴趣，使学生能够应用所学理论知识分析和解决现实问题。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content:
前沿驱动： 内容紧扣管理学各领域最新、最具争议性、最富潜力的研究方向、理论进展、方法论创新和实践挑战。
问题导向： 围绕核心研究问题展开，而非单纯介绍知识。
批判性互动： 鼓励质疑、辩论、深度分析和多元视角。
研究连接： 强化学术前沿与学生自身研究课题的联系。
学者养成： 模拟学术共同体活动，培养学术交流、评价和合作能力。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排

1主题：Introduction to Finance and Financial Research 
2主题：Lemons or Cherries? Growth Opportunities and Market Temptations in Going Public and Private

4 主题：MIS 的主要领域与研究方向——新媒体分析学与网站分析学/企业分析学、移动商务与创新与战略 
5 主题：国际商务学的发展和中国学者的作为 
6 主题：战略管理理论的发展和全球战略聚焦/组织行为研究现状和前沿问题
7 主题：会计学科体系之简单介绍 
8 主题：实证会计理论/经典文献介绍 
9 主题：产业经济学基本理论方法 
10 主题：双边市场理论与应用/网络竞争与规制 
11 主题：市场营销基础 
12 主题：品牌营销管理/网络环境下的服务营销

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 本课程系统介绍经济、管理和社会学各领域研究中常用的定量统计分析方法，主要内容包括数据描述、列联表分析、Logistic 回归模型、方差分析、生存分析、主成分分析、因子分析、机器学习初步（分类与聚类）等。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course provides a systematic introduction to quantitative statistical analysis methods commonly used in research across the fields of economics, management, and sociology. The main content includes data description, contingency table analysis, Logistic regression models, analysis of variance, survival analysis, principal component analysis, factor analysis, and an introduction to machine learning (classification and clustering).

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content: 通过本课程的学习，帮助学生系统地掌握列联表分析、Logistic 回归模型、方差分析、生存分析、主成分分析、因子分析、分类与聚类等经济与管理中常用的定量分析方法，并能够运用统计软件（如SPSS等）具体实施这些方法，分析软件输出报告，并结合实际问题背景解读报告。

paragraphs.heading: 教学方式
paragraphs.content: 授课教师课堂讲解，学生通过作业反馈学习成效。

paragraphs.heading: 教学内容与进度安排
paragraphs.content:
第一周   背景介绍、数据收集、描述统计方法

第二周   列联表分析 (1)：列联表的独立性检验

第三周   列联表分析 (2)：列联表的相关性度量、相对风险与优比、分层列联表

第四周   广义线性模型 (1)：二值Logistic回归的基本思想、估计与检验

第五周   广义线性模型 (2)：二值Logistic回归的变量选择、拟合优度与预测

第六周   广义线性模型 (3)：多值Logistic回归建模、广义线性模型一般方法

第七周   方差分析：单因素方差分析、多重比较、双因素方差分析

第八周   生存分析

第九周   主成分分析、对应分析

第十周   因子分析

第十一周  机器学习 (1)：基本思想介绍

第十二周  机器学习 (2)：分类与聚类

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（中文）
paragraphs.content: 这门课为进行科学研究的基础课程，适合社科大类中研究类型的学生在低年级时进行学习。整个课程从最基础的研究哲学讲起，随后过度到研究要素的解析，以及具体研究方法的解读。这些研究方法重点包括：二手数据法、问卷调查法、实验研究法以及案例研究方法。通过学习，学生们应具有发现有趣的研究问题，转化为科学问题的能力，通过阅读文献，提出研究提案，并在此基础上选择合适的研究方法进行研究设计。

paragraphs.heading: 课程简介（英文）
paragraphs.content: This course serves as a foundational introduction to scientific research, designed for lower-division students in social sciences with a focus on research-oriented studies. The curriculum begins with fundamental research philosophy, then progresses to the analysis of research components and the interpretation of specific methodologies. Key research methods covered include: Secondary Data Analysis, Survey Research, Experimental Research, and Case Study Research. By the end of the course, students will develop the ability to: Identify compelling research questions and refine them into scientifically testable problems; Conduct literature reviews and draft research proposals; Select appropriate methodologies and design robust research frameworks.

paragraphs.heading: 教学目标
paragraphs.content:
1. 了解研究中所需要用到的构念、理论、自变量、因变量、调节变量和中介变量等基本概念；

2. 对社科大类的各种研究方法进行基础性和概要性的理解；

3.  学会发现研究问题，锁定研究领域，掌握基本的文献阅读方法，并能够根据选定的具体研究方法进行研究，为未来的具体研究撰写研究提案。
